prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [sign_in, redesign] Cloud Account Pet Sync Security Showcase: Redesigns the sign_in screen to a split layout with a prominent cloud persistence badge ensuring users that pet customizations are linked securely to their account. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding pets missing or resetting after signing back in.)
1: [adoption, new_screen] Pet Generation Quality Proofing Screen: Adds a new screen 'new_preview_proofing' after photo upload for users to preview custom pet expressions and verify generation output before signing the certificate. (why: Adoption step has low conversion (69.4%) and support emails report custom pet generation failures or unexpected results.)
2: [home, wait_info] Desktop Display Compatibility Checklist: Adds a display overlay compatibility checklist to the waiting screen while background assets are prepared. (why: Support logged 3 emails about pets not displaying on the desktop screen or failing to launch.)
3: [adoption, redesign] Upload Photos Real-Time Quality Guidance: Redesigns the upload_photos screen into a split layout featuring interactive photo quality guidelines and visual validation indicators. (why: Adoption funnel drops to 69.4% and users report issues with custom pet photo rendering.)
4: [choose_path, layout] Two-Column Path Speed vs Customization Comparison: Updates choose_path layout to 'two_column' presenting instant preset companions side-by-side with custom AI creation and clear time expectations. (why: The choose_path screen has a high mean duration of 514s indicating user decision paralysis.)
5: [sign_in, copy] Cross-Device Data Recovery Sign-In Microcopy: Updates headline, body, and hint on the sign_in screen to reassure users that signing in prevents pet profile resets across app updates. (why: Support received 8 emails about pet data loss after re-signing in.)
6: [home, hint] Desktop Habitat Progress Status Hint: Adds explicit status hint updates on the waiting screen explaining background companion generation tasks. (why: Home waiting median duration is 201s, causing drop-offs prior to launch completion.)
7: [choose_path, redesign] Story Screen Companion Teaser Showcase: Redesigns the story screen into a spotlight layout featuring an animated preview of desktop companions interacting live. (why: Overall onboarding funnel completion is low (29.6%), and an engaging visual intro boosts early progression.)
